title: Mandate 74 distillation & release-qualification automation: local-harvest audit in release-qualify/push-policy, disjoint-scope lanes, stable patch-ids & harvest receipts in local-distill
goal: Implement Mandate 74 §§3, 5 & 10 integration across local-distill and release-qualify: (1) wire local-harvest audit directly into release-qualify before any build/test gate (both --verify-only and full qualification), record harvest_audit in releases/qualification/<tag>.json, and enforce in release_qualification::verify_tag (push-policy) that any qualified tree carrying .agents/harvest/*.json manifests or harvest_audit must pass with zero violations; (2) add deterministic disjoint-scope lane partitioning (lanes), git patch-id --stable recording (patch_id), canonical/alias susi-harvest-manifest-v1 + Harvest:/Origin:/Origin-License: trailer verification (verify-harvest and harvest_audit in susi-distillation-receipt-v1), and hook-disabled quarantine-fetch in xtask/src/distill/mandate74.rs + xtask/src/distill_compose.rs.

acceptance: cargo test --offline --locked -p xtask --bin local-distill --bin release-qualify --bin local-harvest --test distilled_release_promotion
cargo test --offline --locked --test architecture_tests --test orphan_sources --test no_github_coupling --test core_docs_promise_no_ui_or_plugins --test task_records --test lean_core_ceilings
limitations: Enforces recorded .agents/harvest/*.json manifests, Apache-2.0 §4(a)-(d) obligations, and Harvest: commit trailers during local-distill and release-qualify / push-policy; unrecorded manual ports without manifests or Harvest: trailers remain outside automatic detection.
